notes: Original PDF title and DOI match supplied reference; journal publication is 2012, with 2011 copyright/online date. Replication PDF title, authors and DOI match supplied reference; cached version has provisional journal pagination, so locations use numbered PDF pages. Chose the 2-year-old paired comparison because original locator p.6 identifies the 24-month-old within-subject result. Replication p.9 also reports the pooled-age ANOVA F(1,28) = 11.84, P < 0.01; 3-year-old paired t(15) = 2.47, P < 0.05; and separate nonparametric analyses. Those refer to different samples/tests and are not combined with the extracted age-matched t test. Informing in replication includes speech as well as gestures, as documented by the authors.
